data.name: DbUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE tblQuotes SET StateID = @StateID, UnderwriterUserGuid = @UnderwriterUserGuid, LineGUID = @LineGUID, CompanyLocationGuid = @CompanyLocationGuid, EffectiveDate = @EffectiveDate, ExpirationDate = @ExpirationDate, QuotingLocationGuid = @QuotingLocationGuid, IssuingLocationGuid = @IssuingLocationGuid, ProducerContactGuid = @ProducerContactGuid, PolicyTypeID = @PolicyTypeID, DateCreated = @DateCreated, SubmissionGroupGuid = @SubmissionGroupGuid, QuoteGUID = @QuoteGUID, BillingTypeID = @BillingTypeID, ControlNo = @ControlNo, TACSRUserGuid = @TACSRUserGuid, EndorsementEffective = @EndorsementEffective, EndorsementComment = @EndorsementComment, FinanceCompanyGuid = @FinanceCompanyGuid, ControlGuid = @ControlGuid, RetailerGuid = @RetailerGuid, MinimumEarnedPercentage = @MinimumEarnedPercentage, AccountNumber = @AccountNumber, CostCenterID = @CostCenterID, InspectionCompanyID = @InspectionCompanyID, SIC_Code = @SIC_Code, QuickQuote = @QuickQuote, PreviousPremium = @PreviousPremium, TargetPremium = @TargetPremium, ExpiringPolicyNumber = @ExpiringPolicyNumber, RiskDescription = @RiskDescription, UnderwritingAssistantGuid = @UnderwritingAssistantGuid, ProducerLocationID = @ProducerLocationID, SecProducerContactGuid = @SecProducerContactGuid, EarnedPremiumTypeID = @EarnedPremiumTypeID, Auditable = @Auditable, NAICSCode = @NAICSCode, RenewalOfQuoteGuid = @RenewalOfQuoteGuid, RenewalOfControlNum = @RenewalOfControlNum WHERE (QuoteGUID = @Original_QuoteGUID)

data.name: DbSelectCommand3.CommandText
data.value: SELECT dbo.tblQuoteDetails.QuoteGuid, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.CompanyLineGuid, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.CompanyContactGuid, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.CompanyCommission, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.ProducerCommission, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.Participation, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.TermsOfPayment, dbo.GetCompanyLineState(dbo.tblQuoteDetails.CompanyLineGuid) AS CompanyLine, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.IntermediaryContactGuid, dbo.tblCompanyLineCommissions.UsingAdditiveCommission, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.ProgramID, dbo.tblQuoteDetails.SLA_Number FROM dbo.tblQuoteDetails INNER JOIN dbo.tblCompanyLines ON dbo.tblQuoteDetails.CompanyLineGuid = dbo.tblCompanyLines.CompanyLineGUID INNER JOIN dbo.tblCompanyLineCommissions ON dbo.tblCompanyLines.CompanyLineID = dbo.tblCompanyLineCommissions.CompanyLineID WHERE (dbo.tblQuoteDetails.QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid) ORDER BY dbo.tblCompanyLineCommissions.Effective DESC

data.name: DbInsertCommand1.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO tblQuotes (StateID, UnderwriterUserGuid, LineGUID, CompanyLocationGuid, EffectiveDate, ExpirationDate, QuotingLocationGuid, IssuingLocationGuid, ProducerContactGuid, PolicyTypeID, DateCreated, SubmissionGroupGuid, QuoteGUID, BillingTypeID, ControlNo, TACSRUserGuid, EndorsementEffective, EndorsementComment, FinanceCompanyGuid, ControlGuid, RetailerGuid, MinimumEarnedPercentage, AccountNumber, CostCenterID, InspectionCompanyID, SIC_Code, QuickQuote, PreviousPremium, TargetPremium, ExpiringPolicyNumber, RiskDescription, UnderwritingAssistantGuid, ProducerLocationID, SecProducerContactGuid, EarnedPremiumTypeID, Auditable, NAICSCode, RenewalOfQuoteGuid, RenewalOfControlNum) VALUES (@StateID,@UnderwriterUserGuid,@LineGUID,@CompanyLocationGuid,@EffectiveDate,@ExpirationDate,@QuotingLocationGuid,@IssuingLocationGuid,@ProducerContactGuid,@PolicyTypeID,@DateCreated,@SubmissionGroupGuid,@QuoteGUID,@BillingTypeID,@ControlNo,@TACSRUserGuid,@EndorsementEffective,@EndorsementComment,@FinanceCompanyGuid,@ControlGuid,@RetailerGuid,@MinimumEarnedPercentage,@AccountNumber,@CostCenterID,@InspectionCompanyID,@SIC_Code,@QuickQuote,@PreviousPremium,@TargetPremium,@ExpiringPolicyNumber,@RiskDescription,@UnderwritingAssistantGuid,@ProducerLocationID,@SecProducerContactGuid,@EarnedPremiumTypeID,@Auditable,@NAICSCode,@RenewalOfQuoteGuid,@RenewalOfControlNum)

data.name: DbSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT Q.StateID, Q.UnderwriterUserGuid, Q.LineGUID, Q.CompanyLocationGuid, Q.EffectiveDate, Q.ExpirationDate, Q.QuotingLocationGuid, Q.IssuingLocationGuid, Q.ProducerContactGuid, Q.PolicyTypeID, Q.DateCreated, Q.SubmissionGroupGuid, Q.QuoteGUID, Q.BillingTypeID, Q.ControlNo, Q.TACSRUserGuid, Q.EndorsementEffective, Q.EndorsementComment, Q.FinanceCompanyGuid, Q.ControlGuid, Q.RetailerGuid, P.Name AS Retailer, Q.MinimumEarnedPercentage, Q.AccountNumber, Q.CostCenterID, Q.InspectionCompanyID, Q.SIC_Code, Q.QuickQuote, Q.PreviousPremium, Q.TargetPremium, Q.ExpiringPolicyNumber, Q.RiskDescription, P.ProducerLocationGUID, Q.UnderwritingAssistantGuid, Q.ProducerLocationID, Q.SecProducerContactGuid, Q.EarnedPremiumTypeID, Q.Auditable, Q.NAICSCode, Q.RenewalOfQuoteGuid, Q.RenewalOfControlNum FROM tblQuotes AS Q LEFT OUTER JOIN tblProducerLocations AS P ON Q.RetailerGuid = P.ProducerLocationGUID WHERE (Q.QuoteGUID = @QuoteGuid)

data.name: DbUpdateCommand2.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE dbo.tblQuoteDetails SET QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid, CompanyLineGuid = @CompanyLineGuid, CompanyContactGuid = @CompanyContactGuid, CompanyCommission = @CompanyCommission, ProducerCommission = @ProducerCommission, Participation = @Participation, TermsOfPayment = @TermsOfPayment, IntermediaryContactGuid = @IntermediaryContactGuid, ProgramID = @ProgramID, SLA_Number = @SLA_Number WHERE (QuoteGuid = @Original_QuoteGuid) AND (CompanyLineGuid = @Original_CompanyLineGuid); SELECT QuoteGuid, CompanyLineGuid, CompanyContactGuid, CompanyCommission, ProducerCommission, Participation, TermsOfPayment, IntermediaryContactGuid FROM tblQuoteDetails WHERE (CompanyLineGuid = @CompanyLineGuid) AND (QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid)

data.name: DbInsertCommand2.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO dbo.tblQuoteDetails (QuoteGuid, CompanyLineGuid, CompanyContactGuid, CompanyCommission, ProducerCommission, Participation, TermsOfPayment, IntermediaryContactGuid, ProgramID, SLA_Number) VALUES (@QuoteGuid,@CompanyLineGuid,@CompanyContactGuid,@CompanyCommission,@ProducerCommission,@Participation,@TermsOfPayment,@IntermediaryContactGuid,@ProgramID,@SLA_Number); SELECT QuoteGuid, CompanyLineGuid, CompanyContactGuid, CompanyCommission, ProducerCommission, Participation, TermsOfPayment, IntermediaryContactGuid FROM tblQuoteDetails WHERE (CompanyLineGuid = @CompanyLineGuid) AND (QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid)
